title: A session's page now has a Timeline tab

owner_note.text: The Timeline lists everything that happened in a session, oldest first, live, with a Filters menu; log lines are hidden by default. The short link /framework/ai/sessions/e00f55c9/ now opens the session too. Next: on a phone the stats bar fills a third of the screen above every tab, so it goes to one line.
